description: The same authored allocation and uncertainty model; seat observation changes no arithmetic or random draws. Only N12 active poll changed between snapshots. Historical-accuracy weights; compulsory poll error; baseline turnout2022.
motivationDefinition: Relative +/-5% voting-mass factors apply to the four non-Arab opposition parties and seven coalition parties listed below. Raam/Joint/Hendel remain unassigned and do not receive opposition motivation. Their potential cooperation is evaluated by summing their seats in each identical trial, without a second turnout boost.
arabTurnoutDefinition: 60% is the absolute recorded locality-turnout setting, compared with the 2022 locality baseline, using the authored geographic-response assumptions. It is a scenario, not an estimate of future participation.
uncertaintyDefinition: MajorityCI is a Wilson Monte Carlo interval over 10,000 trials; seat intervals are simulated outcome ranges. These probabilities are model-conditional capacities for61, not probabilities of forming a real government or a significance test of the newest poll.
